name: Cannon County, Tennessee (United States)
description: White field with the Confederate battle flag in the canton and a red vertical stripe at the fly bearing a white map of the county with CANNON COUNTY TENNESSEE 1836.
history: Cannon County is a county located in Tennessee. The flag was adopted on 17 July 1993 (adopted unanimously by the Cannon County Commission on 17 July 1993; after controversy the commission ruled on 16 October 1993 that it fly at the Confederate monument and at the courthouse only on three state days, an authority upheld by the Tennessee Supreme Court in 1994, according to Flags of the World).
